responsibility: Implements the scanning layer of RTL dataflow analysis, turning instructions and CFG boundary conditions into df_ref objects and per-insn/per-register chains. It records defs, uses, REG_EQUIV/REG_EQUAL note uses, multiword hard-reg accesses, artificial entry/exit refs, regs_ever_live information, and supports incremental rescanning, block/insn ref maintenance, deferred updates, and internal verification that downstream RTL dataflow problems rely on.
